claim_boundary: This checkpoint used future RGB, geometry, and track observations from the same case. It is an offline reconstruction-capacity control, not a causal forecast, transfer result, calibration result, or state-of-the-art claim.

metric_contract.chamfer_distance_m: Per-frame mean one-way L1 nearest-neighbor distance from visible observed object points to predicted surface points, then frame mean.
metric_contract.compatibility: Matches the released PhysTwin evaluate_chamfer.py and evaluate_track.py definitions.
metric_contract.track_error_m: Frame-0 nearest-vertex correspondence for finite manual tracks; per-frame mean Euclidean error, then frame mean.
